[[File:Clonewaryounglings.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Younglings of a number of species play with [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] action figures.]]
'''Action figures''' were small toys in the shape of [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], [[Droid/Legends|droids]], and a variety of other beings and objects. Children played with them.<ref name="JF">[[Star Wars: Jango Fett (one-shot)|''Star Wars: Jango Fett'']]</ref><ref name="GCG">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

Action figures were made of a variety of subjects, including [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/is]], [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s, [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|super battle droids]], [[DSD1 dwarf spider droid/Legends|spider droids]], [[OG-9 homing spider droid/Legends|spider walkers]], [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank/Legends|''Hailfire'' droids]], [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]],<ref name="GCG" /> and [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]].<ref name="JF" />

As a child, [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] played with a Mandalorian figure that looked like [[Jango Fett/Legends|his father]], with which he staged mock battles against the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. He also owned figures of [[Starship/Legends|starships]], which he played with Jango.<ref name="JF" /> [[Youngling/Legends|Younglings]] of many [[Species/Legends|species]] battled with action figures of the soldiers and droids of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="GCG" />
